verdict.rationale: Pulumi Neo is described as an agent that takes plain-English requests, executes changes, and monitors outcomes automatically, and the MCP server can delegate tasks to Neo. That points to some autonomous agent execution. However, nothing documents user-configured automations that run unattended in the background, such as scheduled or triggered jobs. Automation API is a developer building block for constructing such automations, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented scheduled, recurring or event-triggered background automations; details of how Neo tasks run asynchronously and unattended; independent or hands-on corroboration.
